README: Research dataset for a Dubai fertility directory / marketplace.
Dubai, UAE. A few records are explicitly marked as UAE/Sharjah-serving providers where relevant to Dubai patients.

Business/address/phone fields were checked against current Google Maps/business-search results where available. The workbook uses Google Maps SEARCH links rather than claiming an exact Google Place URL.
This is a research shortlist, not a medical recommendation. Discovery used current Dubai fertility directories, Google Maps/business listings, DHA records and official provider sites.
Fields are separated into verified/current vs needs-confirmation. Blank fields mean no reliable public source was found during this pass.
Only numbers explicitly published as WhatsApp/contact numbers are included. Do not infer WhatsApp from a normal phone number.
Exact social URLs were only included where reliably identified; otherwise the sheet records platforms/status rather than inventing a profile URL.
Published prices are included only when found. Otherwise 'Not publicly published; request quote' is used.

Dubai has limited publicly indexed individual embryology/IVF technician data. This tab therefore includes named embryologists/lab professionals that are publicly documented and flags records whose current Dubai location is not independently confirmed.
Healthcare business details, staff, prices, licenses and services can change. Reconfirm directly before publishing or importing into a live directory.
